title: India textiles minister opens weavers centre at NIFT Mumbai
content:
Giriraj Singh opened a Bunakar Seva Kendra at NIFT Mumbai’s Kharghar campus and met fashion students.
The visit linked textile education with handloom services, artisan opportunities, exports and employment generation.
Singh urged students to build on craft and design while adopting sustainability, material innovation, AI, blockchain and 3D printing.

title: Indian business delegation visiting Japan to strengthen trade links
content:
Piyush Goyal will visit Japan from August 24 to 27, 2026, with India’s largest-ever business delegation, comprising more than 200 representatives.
Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka engagements will target deeper trade and investment ties with Keidanren, investors and Japanese companies.
Roadshows will showcase India’s manufacturing, clean energy and consumer markets to Japanese industrial groups.

title: India automates EO extensions to ease export, import compliance
content:
India’s Directorate General of Foreign Trade has automated approved export obligation extensions under Advance Authorisation and Export Promotion Capital Goods schemes.
Committee-approved exporters no longer need a second application to regional authorities.
Revised expiry dates will be updated and sent to the Indian Customs Electronic Gateway, aiding firms with export commitments.

title: India’s polyester raw material takes upward route on rising crude oil
content:
Indian polyester raw material and yarn prices rose in the week ended August 22, 2026, as higher PTA costs lifted polyester melt prices.
POY, PTY and FDY prices were raised, while PSF producers announced a further ₹2 (~$0.02) per kg increase effective August 24.
China PTA and MEG also strengthened, adding feedstock pressure alongside firmer crude oil markets.

title: Vietnam revising EPR rules to boost direct recycling duties
content:
Vietnam is revising its EPR policy to give producers and importers more direct responsibility for post-use products and packaging.
The proposal would end financial contributions as a route to meet recycling obligations.
Textile, apparel and packaging supply chains may need collection points, recyclers and stronger data controls.
The draft aims to tie compliance to actual recycling outcomes.

title: VIATT 2027 to advance sustainable textile sourcing in Vietnam
content:
VIATT 2027 will return to Ho Chi Minh City from February 24–26, 2027 supporting Vietnam’s shift towards higher-value, sustainable and technology-led textile production.
Covering apparel, home and technical textiles, the fair will connect global suppliers and buyers across the value chain.
Vietnam’s textile and garment exports exceeded $22 billion in H1 2026.

title: Is Morocco emerging as a new hub for Chinese textile investment?
content:
China’s Shengtai Intelligent Manufacturing Group has secured key Hunan approvals for its planned green textile industrial park in Morocco. 
Morocco’s proximity to Europe, trade agreements and textile ecosystem support faster delivery and export-oriented garment manufacturing. 
The move points to complementary Chinese capacity closer to Western markets as apparel sourcing fragments.
